prompt: Create one full-body collectible toy character for a friendly children's 3D factory game. Tactile matte clay and painted plastic, rounded chunky forms, exaggerated chibi proportions: total figure height only THREE HEAD HEIGHTS including helmet; very large head, short compact torso and short legs, rounded mitten-like hands, simple expressive clean face with two dark dot eyes and gentle smile, warm cream/turquoise/coral/ochre palette. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, almost front view with slight three-quarter angle, entire figure and both soles visible, generous margin. Static calm walking stance, modest staggered feet, BOTH shoe soles flat on exactly the same ground plane. Exactly two arms and two legs. Thick intact accessories close to body, clear silhouettes, no loose thin parts. No platform, no scenery, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no duplicate person, no extra limbs. Single production reference for image-to-3D. Character: female factory technician, warm brown skin, oval smiling face, short dark hair tucked under a yellow hard hat. Teal overalls over a cream short-sleeve shirt, compact coral tool pouch attached firmly at hip with only two blunt chunky tool handles visible. Sturdy cream-and-teal shoes. Arms relaxed slightly away from torso. Medium build, distinct from broad foreman.
